title: Playing the Wind for Whitetail: A Practical Field Guide
desc: How wind, thermals and terrain carry your scent, and how to pick stands, entry routes and exit routes that keep deer from smelling you.
app: In Your World Hunt, the map shows wind direction and the pressure trend for your spot, and Ask Hawk can tell you which of your marked stands fits the forecast wind on each Hunt Day.

title: The First-Time Elk Hunt Checklist
desc: Fitness, scouting, tags, glassing, gear and meat care: a step-by-step checklist for planning your first elk hunt without the classic mistakes.
app: Plan a Hunt keeps the whole elk trip in one place: Hunt Days scored with the forecast, base camp and lodging, the elk backcountry kit, budget, and tag and draw reminders built from the dates you enter from your agency.

title: Moon Phase and Feeding Times: How to Use Them (Honestly)
desc: What solunar tables and moon phases can and can't tell you about deer movement, and how to fit them into a hunting plan alongside weather, wind and the rut.
app: Your World Hunt shows moon phase and sun and moon rise and set for free, and deer feeding times with Premium. Plan a Hunt folds moon, sun and the forecast into each Hunt Day's score, so the moon is one input, not the whole plan.

title: Public Land Hunting Basics: Finding, Scouting and Hunting It
desc: How to find public hunting land, read boundaries, plan access, avoid pressure and hunt it ethically, plus the rules you must confirm before you go.
app: The LAND overlay shows US public-land boundaries live (Premium), and Land Packs work offline. They're informational guides, not a survey. Drop marks for parking, entry points and stands, and use GPS return to get back to the truck in the dark.

title: The Waterfowl Blind Gear List: What to Bring and Why
desc: A complete duck and goose blind gear list covering waders, decoys, calls, concealment, safety in cold water and dog gear, with what actually matters.
app: Mark boat ramps, blinds and decoy spots on the map, check wind and pressure before you launch, and pack from the Waterfowl blind kit in Kits & Gear.

title: Spring Turkey Setup: Roosting, Calling and Decoy Placement
desc: How to locate gobblers, set up on a roosted bird, place decoys, call with restraint and stay safe in the spring turkey woods.
app: Drop marks where birds gobble at dawn and fly down, track your walk in, and use the forecast for wind and rain on each Hunt Day. The Spring turkey kit in Kits & Gear covers the calls, vest and decoys.

title: Planning Your First Plains-Game Safari
desc: Choosing an outfitter, understanding daily rates and trophy fees, shooting off sticks, packing and travel paperwork for a first African plains-game safari.
app: Plan a Hunt has a Safari destination with the plains-game kit, a papers checklist (passport, firearm permit paperwork, insurance, outfitter contract), budget in your currency and a trip PDF to share with your party.

title: Rangefinding and Shot Distance Basics
desc: Why knowing the distance matters, how laser rangefinders and other methods work, angle and wind basics, and how to set an ethical maximum range.
app: Sharp Shooter in Your World Hunt is an on-device camera rangefinder and wind hold guide. It gives a quick estimate, not a laser reading, and it isn't a ballistic calculator. Calibrate it on a known distance and use a laser rangefinder to confirm.
